display.purpose: Major marketing theses in one or two decisive lines.

headline.purpose: Strong feature statements inside large editorial surfaces.

body.purpose: Approachable explanatory marketing copy at a readable measure.

label.purpose: Sparse category labels and eyebrows; compact scene copy remains sentence case.

shadows.name: navigation-float
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for the fixed charcoal header after it leaves the hero surface.

shadows.name: overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus and temporary dark overlays.

shadows.name: product-window-depth
shadows.purpose: A single major product window against the dark hero.

shadows.name: evidence-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Fine-pointer feedback for a product-scene preview; pair with a five-pixel lift.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Primary reveal, overlay, and state-transition easing.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Slow ambient hero movement where motion is explicitly justified.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Hover, expansion, focus-adjacent, and navigation surface changes.

motion.name: section-reveal
motion.purpose: One-time opacity, blur, and vertical reveal with 110ms item staggering.

motion.name: product-state-story
motion.purpose: One-time product-state transitions whose duration follows the demonstrated action.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive marketing action on dark or light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--green); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--green); color: #fff; font-family: Altone, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2fc762; border-color: #2fc762; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Dark Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action designed for the charcoal hero and navigation surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); border-radius: 8px; background: #171719; color: #fff; font-family: Altone, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #252529; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.28); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Compact Navigation
components.description: The fixed charcoal navigation treatment and its compact item states, shown without replacing the approved logo asset.
components.html: RakanSalesProductSolutionsLog In
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(23,23,25,.97); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12); font-family: Altone, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav__brand { margin-right: 12px; color: var(--green); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav__item, .ds-nav__login { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #f7f7f8; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-nav__item:hover { background: #2a2a2e; } .ds-nav__login { margin-left: auto; background: var(--green); color: #fff; } .ds-nav__login:hover { background: #2fc762; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Announcement Pill
components.description: A compact hero update that layers a short status label with one credible product message.
components.html: NewAI Lead Finder is now in RakanSales
components.css: .ds-announcement { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 34px; padding: 3px 12px 3px 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(18,18,20,.72); color: #f1f1f3; font-family: Altone, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-announcement span { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 26px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #343438; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-announcement strong { font-weight: 500; } .ds-announcement:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.28); background: #202023; } .ds-announcement:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Product Story Panel
components.description: A flat story panel intended to sit inside a shared evidence frame when several workflows form one connected system.
components.html:
Discover opportunities.

Find and capture leads from every connected source.
components.css: .ds-story { width: min(100%, 360px); padding: 20px; background: #f7f8f5; color: #111312; font-family: Altone, Arial, sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-story h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-story p { max-width: 36ch; margin: 12px auto 0; color: #5d625d; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-story__preview { display: grid; gap: 8px; min-height: 150px; margin-top: 28px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #dfe3de; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; transition: transform 420ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 420ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-story__preview span { display: block; height: 34px; border: 1px solid #e2e5e1; border-radius: 7px; background: #fafbf9; } .ds-story:hover .ds-story__preview { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 18px 36px rgba(34,45,36,.1); } .ds-story:focus-within .ds-story__preview { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Code-Native Product Scene
components.description: An example of the authored product-evidence method; content and internal composition must be rebuilt around the supported workflow being explained.
components.css: .ds-scene { width: min(100%, 420px); margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #202420; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #dde1dc; font-family: Altone, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-scene__toolbar { margin: 14px; min-height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #dfe3de; border-radius: 7px; color: #606860; } .ds-scene__row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 8px 10px; min-height: 58px; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid #2cc160; border-radius: 8px; background: #f1fbf4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35,183,80,.07); } .ds-scene__check { display: grid; width: 15px; height: 15px; place-items: center; border-radius: 3px; background: #20ae4c; color: #fff; font-size: 9px; } .ds-scene__row em { padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e1f6e6; color: #126f32; font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; } .ds-scene__route { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(34px,1fr) 32px auto; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin: 8px 12px 12px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e5e1; border-radius: 8px; background: #fbfcfa; } .ds-scene__route i { height: 1px; background: #20b74d; } .ds-scene__route b { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; border-radius: 7px; background: #15943b; color: #fff; font-size: 16px; } .ds-scene:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lime); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Trust Evidence Item
components.description: A compact text-first proof point separated by a mineral hairline rather than a floating card.
components.css: .ds-evidence { min-height: 62px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 32px; border-left: 1px solid #bfc3bd; background: #f1f2ee; color: #171917; font-family: Altone, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence p { margin: 0; color: #666a66; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-evidence strong { color: #171917; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
RakanSales should feel like the calm, capable workspace of a trusted Malaysian sales partner: operationally credible, immediately understandable to an SME owner, and composed enough for enterprise review. The system pairs a pale mineral canvas with compact charcoal framing and uses RakanSales green as a deliberate signal rather than ambient decoration.

The visual voice is premium B2B SaaS without generic dashboard gloss. Large editorial statements establish the promise, while compact, code-native product scenes provide concrete proof. Those scenes are a reusable evidence pattern, not a mandate to repeat any particular section copy, three-column composition, or workflow on every page.
keyCharacteristics: Calm mineral fields with crisp charcoal contrast.
One restrained Rakan green accent system.
Altone typography with wide, decisive display lines and compact interface text.
Low-radius containers, fine dividers, and tightly controlled depth.
Credible HTML/CSS product scenes that explain a product state at a glance.
Purposeful motion that resolves once and respects reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Green Signal Rule
rules.body: Green must communicate identity, action, focus, selection, or progress. Its restraint is what makes it authoritative.

rules.name: The Mineral Field Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation and hairlines to organise light sections; do not fill every container with a different neutral.

rules.name: The Wide Thesis Rule
rules.body: Give display copy enough measure to land in intentional, balanced lines; do not force a strong statement into a narrow multi-line stack by default.

rules.name: The Interface Legibility Rule
rules.body: Compact product scenes may be dense, but visible mobile scene copy must not fall below the established 10px floor.

rules.name: The Shared Frame Rule
rules.body: When several product stories belong to one system, prefer one shared container with internal hairlines over a row of unrelated floating cards.

rules.name: The Density Handoff Rule
rules.body: Keep marketing copy spacious, then let the product evidence become compact; do not use dashboard density for the entire page.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting light surfaces are organised by tone and hairlines. Add shadow only when it explains layering, state, or a hero focal object.

rules.name: The Radius Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Increase radius with container scale, but keep the silhouette taut; do not turn major B2B surfaces into oversized capsules.

rules.name: The Credible Scene Rule
rules.body: A product scene must make one supported workflow legible at a glance. Do not add generic dashboard chrome, fake controls, or unsupported metrics to make it look busier.

rules.name: The One-Time Motion Rule
rules.body: Product-state motion demonstrates causality once, then gets out of the way; it never loops as decoration.

dos: Do preserve the approved RakanSales logo, Altone typography, Malaysian relevance, and recognisable green identity.
Do use generous mineral space around compact, information-rich evidence.
Do keep primary actions, focus, selection, and progress visually distinct and accessible.
Do use real product screenshots when available and code-native scenes when a focused workflow explanation is clearer.
Do keep product-scene figures non-interactive unless the surrounding experience explicitly introduces real controls.
Do verify desktop and mobile layouts, keyboard focus, contrast, zoom, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn the product into a loose grid of equal feature cards; connected workflows should read as one operating system.
Don't use green as a broad decorative wash or introduce competing accent colors without product meaning.
Don't add excessive glass, oversized radii, heavy card shadows, or ornamental depth to mineral sections.
Don't fabricate performance figures, customer outcomes, integrations, or product behavior inside visual evidence.
Don't generalise the current three-scene composition, its copy, or its section-specific dimensions into a site-wide template.
Don't loop product-state animations or hide final content from reduced-motion users.
